name: Avnish Kumar Mishra
title: Lead Java Engineer & Technical Architect
tagline: I design and lead delivery of high-throughput, cloud-native microservice platforms for global enterprises.
summary: Java Technical Lead and Architect with over 13 years and 10 months of software engineering experience across enterprise product development, distributed system design and large-scale microservice architectures. I lead cross-functional engineering teams and stay hands-on in Core Java (8–17), Spring Boot, Spring WebFlux, multithreading and cloud-native platforms (AWS, Azure). My focus areas are high-throughput messaging (Kafka), polyglot persistence (MongoDB, Cassandra, MySQL, Oracle) and low-latency API design, along with proactive stakeholder communication, risk mitigation and Agile governance on mission-critical deliveries.
